assets.sourcePrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D pixel art CHARACTER SPRITE SHEET for a React finance life-simulation browser game called BULLISH. Create a square 1024x1024 RGBA sprite sheet, TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, no text. EXACT UNIFORM 4 COLUMNS BY 4 ROWS, 16 frames, each frame centered in its own 256x256 cell. Do NOT draw grid lines or cell borders. One identical adorable chibi young adult finance bro in every frame: huge round head, tiny body, tousled dark brown hair, warm medium skin, expressive dark eyes, cream collared shirt, teal green sweater vest, little golden tie, navy trousers and brown shoes. Cute 3-head-tall JRPG sprite proportions, front-facing 3/4 view, visible complete body including feet, warm and likeable. Real hand-placed retro pixel-art style, chunky hard square pixels, restricted warm woodland green / golden honey / terracotta palette, dark brown 1 logical pixel outlines, no antialiasing, no gradients, no smooth vector look. The same character stays same scale and aligned at the same bottom baseline throughout. Every frame's content must stay fully within the CENTER 65% of its cell leaving transparent padding on all sides. ROW 1 from left to right: 4 idle animation frames, subtle bounce and blink, empty hands. ROW 2: 4 walking cycle frames facing right with alternating legs and arms, empty hands. ROW 3: 4 celebrating animation frames, hands raised, happy face, tiny pixel sparkle above head but entirely inside cell. ROW 4: 4 reading newspaper animation frames, holding a tiny cream newspaper and slight head movement. This is a functional aligned sprite atlas, not a character concept poster. No shadows outside cells, no labels, no watermark, no checkerboard drawn into the actual image.
